text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
*Phew*~! That was so much fun~! 
Maruzen-chan, nice drive!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
What do you wanna do next? The beach, the 
mountains... I'll take you somewhere 
totally hip~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, I wanna go to an 
all-you-can-eat sweets buffet! And a crepe 
shop, and~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Maya-chan, have you been a bit 
of a glutton lately?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? That's not true at all! Even 
yesterday, for lunch Maya had pasta and...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Cake, pudding... taiyaki, and, umm... 
umm...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, let's go! Hop on, hop on!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
N-No! If I eat any more than this, 
Trainer-chan is gonna be completely 
disillusioned with meee!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's right, so............ off to the 
gym we GO!

Thanks to Maruzensky's go-to gym, Mayano 
Top Gun managed to successfully pull off 
her diet!
